newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arab League holds meeting on Mideast peace crisis.
newsitem.headline: Arab League holds meeting on Mideast peace crisis.

text.p: The Arab League on Tuesday began an extraordinary meeting of its permanent representatives in Cairo to discuss the crisis in Middle East peacemaking, witnesses said.
The meeting of its 22 council members came in response to a Palestinian call to assess the crisis in Palestinian-Israeli peacemaking.

The request comes after Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's cabinet suspended peace talks with the Palestinian Authority and demanded the crackdown on Moslem militants responsible for a double suicide bombing in a Jerusalem market on Wednesday that killed 13 people and wounded 170.
